full_roster_injury_deep_dive.context: Multiple rostered players are coming off surgeries with genuinely disputed recovery timelines across outlets -- a quick web_search per player misses the synthesis a full comparison needs.
questions: For each ACL/meniscus recovery on the roster, what do multiple current sources say about expected weeks-to-full-effectiveness, and where do sources disagree?
Which of these players have a documented history of setbacks or revision surgeries that should lower confidence in an optimistic timeline?
Are there any recent (last 7 days) practice-report changes that would update these outlooks?
suggested_sources: Official team injury reports for each player's team
Beat-writer camp coverage from the last 2 weeks
Any available clinical/recovery-timeline articles for the specific injury type

rookie_draft_scouting.topic: Rookie scouting for the upcoming 3-round rookie draft
rookie_draft_scouting.context: The league's actual draft this year is rookie-only (3 rounds), which the original startup-draft strategy doc doesn't cover at all.
questions: Which rookies at each roster-need position have the clearest early-season path to playing time based on current depth charts?
For rookies without a clear role yet, what has camp/preseason coverage said about their opportunity trajectory?
Which Round 1-3 rookie-draft-caliber prospects are being flagged as sleepers by multiple independent sources (not just one outlet's hype)?
suggested_sources: Recent rookie scouting reports and draft-slot rankings
Depth chart projections for each rookie's team
rookie_draft_scouting.feed_into: a rookie draft board discussion with Claude directly

trade_target_due_diligence.topic: Due diligence on a specific trade target
trade_target_due_diligence.context: Before finalizing a trade, a deeper look than a quick opportunity-signal check is worth it given the season-long commitment.
questions: What is this player's target/touch share trend over the last month, and is it tied to a matchup fluke or a real role change?
Is there any injury history or current soft-tissue concern that a quick search might miss?
How do this player's remaining-season and playoff-week (specify weeks) matchups look?
suggested_sources: Recent game logs / usage trend articles
Team beat-writer coverage from the last month
trade_target_due_diligence.feed_into: a trade decision discussion with Claude directly

playoff_schedule_deep_dive.topic: Playoff-week (specify weeks) schedule and defensive strength deep dive
playoff_schedule_deep_dive.context: playoff-schedule-strength needs real opponent/defensive-rank data for the confirmed playoff weeks; a broader one-time research pass covering the whole roster is more efficient than searching team by team.
questions: For each NFL team on the roster, who do they play in the confirmed playoff weeks, and does any of them have a bye?
What are current pass-defense and run-defense rankings for each of those opponents?
Have there been any recent defensive-personnel changes (injuries, trades) that would change those rankings soon?
